resale_co.name: Continued Certificate of Occupancy (CCO)
resale_co.issued_by: Construction / Code Enforcement Office (Housing and Zoning Officer)
requirements: Handrails on stairs with 3 or more risers; guardrails on porches or decks 30 inches or higher
No broken windows or doors; all must work
Switch plates and outlet covers in place; light fixtures with shades and no bare wires
No holes in walls or other structural damage; no exterior damage or roof leaks
Smoke detector on every level, within 10 feet of bedroom doors and in every bedroom
Carbon monoxide detector in the hallway within 10 feet of bedroom doors
Mounted ABC fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen (2017 list)
Breaker panel wired with no missing breakers
Hot and cold running water, working toilet, working heater; water heater relief valve extension 2 to 6 inches from the floor
4-inch white post 3 feet tall by the driveway with 3-inch reflective house numbers on two sides
No trash, motor vehicles or debris in the yard; all utilities on at the time of inspection
Bathroom window or exhaust fan; GFCI outlets within 3 feet of sinks
No flaking paint or stains on interior finishes; no double-keyed deadbolts
Water certificate from the Cumberland County Health Department and a septic certification

resale_co.how_to_apply: Call the Construction Office at 856-785-3100 ext. 320 to set up the inspection. Fill out the Application for Continued Certificate of Occupancy (block and lot, owner, seller's agent and buyer's agent) and pay at the time of application by cash, check or money order payable to 'Commercial Township'. Township offices are at 1768 Main Street, Port Norris.

resale_co.notes: The live site (https://www.commercialtwp.com/) shows a bot check, so the Township pages were read from Internet Archive copies: the old Housing page (original https://commercialtwp.com/government/departments/housing/, captured 2025-03-21, page dated 2024-07-10), the old Construction page (captured 2025-06-14) and the new site's Contact Us staff directory (captured 2026-04-01). The site has since moved to a new platform with a Housing Forms & Documents page that could not be opened, so fees may have changed. The CCO form (scanned, 'Updated: March 20, 2017') was read visually; its fees ($75 resale, $40 re-inspection) match the 2024 Housing page. No email is published for the Construction Office; the new site uses contact forms. Rental units must be registered and inspected every year ($100 per year, Ordinance 2004-453); that is a rental program.

requirements: The Township's CCO checklist (2017) checks smoke detectors on every level, within 10 feet of bedroom doors and in every bedroom, a CO detector within 10 feet of bedroom doors, and a mounted ABC fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA (registry code S) is the fire code enforcing agency for Commercial Township. However, the DCA's July 17, 2026 state towns list shows Commercial without the 'SC' (smoke certs) flag, and the fire district data feed that the DCA's online smoke application page loads marks COMMERCIAL TWP-001 as State jurisdiction with 'ultra_smokecertexempt: true'; the page's script removes exempt towns from the application's town list. So the DCA online certificate does not appear to be available here. The Township's resale CCO checklist covers smoke alarms, CO alarms and an extinguisher, and N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3 lets a municipal resale inspection that covers these items stand in for the separate certificate, but no Township page says the CCO serves that purpose. The state fire directory still prints 'NJ Division Fire Safety, PO Box 809' in the smoke detector compliance block for all three Commercial fire companies (Laurel Lake, Mauricetown, Port Norris). The directory gives (609)633-6132 for Louis Kilmer; the Bureau's own page gives (609) 633-6106, which is used here. The 2017 CCO list still requires a fire extinguisher; the February 3, 2025 state law (P.L.2025, c.19) removed it from the state requirement.
